text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 4. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 5. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here. 6.Indexes and abstracts of published theses/dissertation The indexes and abstracts of published theses/dissertation or other materials to prove applicant's research ability. 7.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 8.Academic transcript of highest education
